latestVersion.changelog:
Professional AI Image 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Convert raw JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB) into enhanced, professional-quality 1080p MP4 videos.
- Cloud GPU processing delivers polished exports in about 20-40 seconds; export also supports MOV, AVI, WEBM, MKV, GIF, and more.
- Anonymous users receive a free 7-day token with 100 credits; credits and session management are handled automatically.
- Supports batch processing, iterative editing, and smart action routing based on user prompts (e.g., enhance, export, check credits).
- Detailed error handling and automatic session/token recovery for seamless user experience.
